what: The Item B-1 fixture assumes the cp stub can fail two reuse-copy targets, but the current stub supports one substring and fails only the first matching copy.
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed PHASE2_RELAUNCH_COUNT=2 scenario will either produce only one relaunch or require unsupported ad hoc env setup.
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to include the tiny cp-stub change needed for exactly two planned copy failures, then use that explicit knob in the B-1 scenario.
